CASE STUDY · DEFENCE & SECURITY

Enhancing Readiness Through XR Training.

How a repeatable immersive training environment helped teams practise complex procedures safely, consistently and with clearer performance insight.

Explore the case study ↓Discuss a similar project
THE FOCUSSafe practice. Consistent delivery.
Actionable insight.
INDUSTRYDefence & Security
SOLUTIONImmersive XR Training
TRAINING MODEInstructor-led & Individual
DELIVERYIterative Development
01

OVERVIEW

Training for situations that are difficult to reproduce.

Operational teams need regular opportunities to rehearse procedures, make decisions and learn from mistakes. Access to physical environments, specialist equipment and instructors can be limited, while live exercises may be costly or unsuitable for early-stage practice.

MXR designed an extended reality training experience that placed learners inside a controlled, repeatable scenario. The solution supported guided familiarisation, practical decision-making and structured review without replacing essential live instruction.

THE CHALLENGE

Make complex training easier to access—and easier to assess.

The programme needed to preserve operational context while remaining straightforward for instructors to run and learners to understand.

01

Limited access

Physical training environments and specialist resources were not always available when teams needed to practise.

02

Inconsistent delivery

Training quality could vary between locations, instructors and the conditions available on the day.

03

Low visibility

It was difficult to capture how learners moved through a scenario and where support was required.

02

THE SOLUTION

A connected training experience built around real workflows.

The project combined immersive scenarios, instructor control and structured performance information. Each element was designed around the learning objective rather than technology for its own sake.

01

Immersive scenarios

Contextual environments let learners rehearse approved procedures and decision points at a practical pace.

02

Instructor controls

Facilitators could start sessions, introduce events, observe progress and guide the debrief.

03

Performance review

Structured session information supported consistent feedback and highlighted areas for further practice.

04

Scalable delivery

A reusable content framework made it easier to extend scenarios and support different training contexts.

HOW WE DELIVERED

Collaborative from discovery to deployment.

Subject-matter expertise remained central throughout. Short development cycles allowed procedures, interactions and terminology to be reviewed before the experience was expanded.

  1. 01
    Discover

    Define users, environments, procedures and success criteria.

  2. 02
    Prototype

    Test the critical interaction and instructor workflow early.

  3. 03
    Validate

    Review accuracy, usability, comfort and training relevance.

  4. 04
    Deploy

    Prepare the solution, supporting guidance and future roadmap.

03

THE OUTCOME

A stronger foundation for confident performance.

✓

Repeatable practice

Learners could revisit the same scenario and build familiarity before progressing.

✓

Consistent facilitation

Structured scenarios gave instructors a shared foundation for delivery and debriefing.

✓

Safer early learning

Teams could make and discuss decisions in a controlled environment without operational consequences.

✓

Clearer development priorities

Session review helped identify where learners needed more explanation or practical reinforcement.
